_readme: Impro YouTube channels the auto-feed pulls from (scripts/feed.mjs). Each channel_id was verified to return videos from https://www.youtube.com/feeds/videos.xml?channel_id=<id>. To add a channel: open its YouTube page → View Source → search for "channelId":"UC..." (or visit a video, the page HTML has it) → add an entry below. Only ids matching ^UC[\w-]{20,}$ are used. The feed only proposes videos newer than FEED_DAYS (default 120) days, so dormant channels are harmless.
